sections.heading: Ammo Types
items: Round Shot – standard hull damage. Default for sinking ships quickly.
Bar Shot / Chain Shot – damages sails and rigging. Use it first against faster ships to slow them down.
Grape Shot – anti-crew damage. Softens enemy sailors before boarding.
Explosive Shot – high damage, slower reload. Best for stationary or broadside exchanges.

sections.heading: Tactics
items: Aim for the rear of enemy ships to hit critical weak points and maximize hull damage.
Focus fire one target until disabled, then move to the next. Splitting fire wastes time.
If a ship shows a Sword icon, it is ready to board and has stopped firing. Do not sink it if you want loot.
Kite damaged enemies to repair, then re-engage. Repair kits are your health potions at sea.
In multi-ship fights, sink the first few and board the last one to avoid boarding under fire.

sections.heading: Boarding
items: Park adjacent to the disabled ship and press the prompt key (Space by default).
Your crew sieges while you fight on deck with sword and pistol. Defeat the required number of sailors to win.
Loot Naval Supplies, Medical Crates, and Contraband. Contraband sells well to faction vendors for Piastre.
